leads.title: Lawrence v. Texas (2003) - U.S. Supreme Court
leads.documents: Decriminalized same-sex sexual activity in Texas by declaring sodomy laws unconstitutional; struck down Texas 'deviate sexual intercourse' offense
leads.detail: Cited as June 2003 ruling; Texas sodomy ban history

leads.title: Obergefell v. Hodges (June 26, 2015) - U.S. Supreme Court
leads.documents: Legalized same-sex marriage nationwide, invalidating Texas ban; held same-sex marriage bans breach Equal Protection Clause
leads.detail: Cited as June 26, 2015 decision; Texas Dept of State Health Services estimated 2,500 same-sex licenses issued by September 2015

leads.title: Respect for Marriage Act (2022) - Federal law
leads.documents: Established federal protections for same-sex marriages; requires Texas to recognize same-sex marriages lawfully performed in another state, but does not obligate issuance of licenses

leads.title: Bostock v. Clayton County (2020) - Supreme Court of the United States (SCOTUS)
leads.documents: Established federal employment discrimination protections based on sexual orientation or gender identity; Texas courts recognized in March 2021 as applying in Texas
leads.detail: Cited as 2020 precedent applied in Texas courts March 2021

leads.title: Texas Senate Bill 14 (SB 14) - signed June 2023
leads.documents: Effectively bans gender-affirming care for minors in Texas
leads.detail: Cited as signing of Senate bill 14 (SB 14) in June 2023; follows HB 1399 and SB 1311 efforts in 2021

leads.title: Texas Attorney General Ken Paxton legal opinion and Governor Greg Abbott DFPS directive - February 2022
leads.documents: Declared gender-affirming care for transgender youth as child abuse under state law; directed Texas Department of Family and Protective Services to investigate parents, with reporting duties and criminal penalties
leads.detail: Cited as February 2022 opinion and February 23, 2022 order; five district attorneys said they would not follow; ACLU and Lambda Legal sued

leads.title: Texas Third Court of Appeals - March 2022 injunction ruling
leads.documents: Reinstated temporary injunction barring enforcement of Abbott directive investigating gender-affirming care as child abuse
leads.detail: Cited as March 2022 ruling; ACLU suit on behalf of family investigated; testimony by DFPS supervisor Randy Mulanax on different rules for trans cases

leads.title: Texas House Bill 229 - Women's Bill of Rights - passed May 2025, signed June 2025, effective September 2025
leads.documents: Legally defines male/female based on reproductive systems (ova production/fertilization); explicitly bans any sex changes on Texas documents including drivers licenses and birth certificates; applies to all state statutes using gendered pronouns
leads.detail: Cited as broad bill passed by both houses May 2025, signed June 2025, took effect September 2025

leads.title: Texas Parents' Bill of Rights - signed June 2025
leads.documents: Bars school employees from teaching or discussing race gender identity or sexual orientation; bans LGBT-related student orgs; implements mandatory deadnaming and misgendering for trans students
leads.detail: Cited as signed by Governor Abbott June 2025; education section

leads.title: Yale University rebuttal - July 2022
leads.documents: Point-by-point rebuttal of Texas and Alabama justifications for bans on youth gender-affirming care; states puberty blockers and hormone therapies are safe and effective, not close calls
leads.detail: Cited as July 2022 Yale release stating states ignore established medical authorities and repeat discredited information
